text: BAM share rose 0.4 percentage points over 24 hours and 14.91 percentage points over 7 days, reaching 36.6%. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-2-tee holds 23.7% of BAM stake, while the node Nakamoto coefficient and region Nakamoto coefficient are both 3. Leadership changed hands 68 times in the window, consistent with whale-driven routing rather than a new validated structural rollover.
